message: Research complete: host-driven party game with setup, countdown timer, spin wheel picker, scoreboard, multi-round support
Starting new app pipeline — issue #243: 2 Truths and a Lie game
Selected issue #243: 2 Truths and a Lie — browser-based party game for Zoom screen-share. Source: github-approved.

Reviewed existing party apps (Raffle Night Caller, Charades Chaos Deck). 2 Truths and a Lie is distinct: host-managed turn flow, spinner wheel picker, per-player statement guessing, multi-round scoring. No duplication risk. Design: 6 screens — Setup, Think Timer (round 1 only), Spinner, Turn/Guess, Reveal, Round-end Scoreboard + Final. Dark theme with purple accent, screen-share-friendly large text.

Generated index.html: 6-screen party game — Setup, Think Timer (round 1 only), Spinner wheel, Turn/Guess recording, Reveal with scoring, Round-end Scoreboard + Final. Purple/indigo dark theme, screen-share-friendly large text. Full keyboard/touch support.

Generated thumbnail.svg: spinner wheel mid-spin with 8 player segments, right panel showing guess-recording UI with statement selections. Purple/indigo palette, corner accents, gradient background. xmllint valid.

Starting improvement pipeline — issue #245: spinner alignment fix + host statement capture + thumbnail redo
Selected issue #245: spinner alignment bug (wheel winner doesn't match arrow position) + host statement capture feature + thumbnail redo (wheel distorted). Source: github-approved.

Identified 3 issues: (1) Spinner bug — extraRotations is a float causing spinTarget miscalculation; fix by using integer rotations and corrected modulo formula. (2) Statement capture — turn screen needs 3 text inputs before guess recording; add submitStatements() flow. (3) Thumbnail wheel is not a true circle — replace manual path coords with SVG arc paths from computed points on exact radius.
Backed up pre-improvement files to apps/2026/03/31/two-truths-lie-game/backups/run-20260331T022221Z-d4e8f1/

Three changes: (1) Fixed spinner alignment — changed extraRotations to integer (3-6), rewrote spinTarget using ((2π - ((spinAngle+targetSegmentCenter) % 2π)) % 2π) correction formula. (2) Added statement capture phase to turn screen: 3 text inputs with enable-on-all-filled logic, submitStatements() locks inputs and shows numbered display + guess grid. (3) Reveal screen now shows the 3 statements with lie highlighted in red and truths in green.

Redrew thumbnail.svg with mathematically correct SVG arc paths (A 135 135 0 0 1) clipped by clipPath circle for perfect circular wheel. 8 segments using exact endpoint coordinates. Added clipPath to enforce circular boundary. Right panel updated to show statement inputs + one guess row. xmllint valid.
